title: promotion-report.json
description: Artifact produced by an `operator` stage with `with.operation: promotion`. Lists candidate promotions of run-local artefacts (ADRs, project-context updates, PRDs) into durable repo locations such as docs/decisions/ and .aidp/project-context.md. The agent ONLY proposes; the human (via AskQuestion) ultimately decides via the agent's blocking_questions.json.

promotions.description: One entry per promotion candidate. Empty when there is nothing to promote.

id.description: Stable id for the promotion (e.g. P-adr-001). Mirrors the id used in blocking_questions.json so the human's answer can be matched back.

kind.description: What is being promoted. Decides the default target_path.

candidate_path.description: Absolute path of the source artefact inside the run's stage_dir.

target_path.description: Absolute path proposed by the agent for the destination (must respect the per-stage scope: block declared on the operator promotion stage - typically docs/decisions/**, .aidp/project-context.md, docs/PRDs/**).

action.description: What the agent recommends. The orchestrator calls AskQuestion to confirm with the human; the human's answer wins.

rationale.description: Short justification for the recommended action.

human_decision.description: Filled by the orchestrator AFTER AskQuestion. Null while still pending.
